title: Salt Bubble Candy Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Bubble Candy by SALT delivers a sweet, satisfying hit of sugary bubblegum with hints of blueberry on the inhale and a soft, spearmint note on the super-smooth exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
